This allows you to control the boundaries of agent behavior, without wasting context."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Port of my jiesou/opencode-stream-rules to DSH.
Similar to oh-my-pi's "Time-traveling stream rules","},{"id":"p7s2","text":" but with a very simple and compact code implementation."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"A rule fires when its `match` returns true, against:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **the tool call** — tool name + flattened arguments (numbers included, e.g. `timeoutMs`), before d"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ispatch.
- **the settled result** — after dispatch, the tool's content, status markers (`[timed out "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"after 600000ms]`, `[exit code: 1]`, …) and error text join the match string, so rules describing out"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"comes (a crash, a full disk, a timeout) can match there too. Matching after dispatch can only steer,"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"sh, a full disk, a timeout) can match there too. Matching after dispatch can only steer, never deny."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"On a match:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- **default** — injects a `SYSTEM NOTICE` steering message into the agent (pre-dispatch via `agent.i"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"nject()`, post-dispatch as `additionalContexts` on the tool result — DSH's non-waking "queue model-f"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"acing context for the next pre-step"). The agent retries from the same point, now knowing the rule.
"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"- **`reject: true`** — denies the FIRST tool call (`{ kind: 'deny' }`); later attempts are allowed. "},{"id":"p12s5","text":"Steering without over-restricting, e.g. letting `pip install` through when it's already in a contain"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"ering without over-restricting, e.g. letting `pip install` through when it's already in a container."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Each rule fires at most once per session (per agent), mirroring the original's `notified` dedup."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"From npm (prebuilt, recommended):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Or from GitHub (runs `prepare` to build on install):"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Or add the row to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## After installing"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"You need to write the rules in your own `.js` file.
